How to use this page

  1. Type your words into the yellow boxes. Each one shows the limit Modern Luxury set, and counts as you type so you cannot go over without knowing.
  2. Tap an option to choose it. A tick appears on the one you picked. To see a photograph properly, tap the small arrows in the corner of it.
  3. Press the brown button at the bottom when you are finished. It gathers everything into one message for you to send back to me.

Your typing is saved in this page as you go, so you can close it and come back later. Nothing is sent anywhere until you press the button.
